            About YAPS Music

            YAPS MUSIC is a digital music platform created and developed by YAPS DEVELOPER in Uganda. The platform is designed to connect music lovers with music from Uganda, Africa, and around the world.

            YAPS MUSIC provides music discovery, streaming, playlists, artists, albums, videos, creator features, and other digital music experiences.

            Developer Information
            OwnerYAPS DEVELOPER
            DeveloperYAPS DEVELOPER
            ProductYAPS MUSIC
            OriginUganda
            VisionMusic to the World
            PlatformWeb / PWA
            StatusContinuously Developing
            Developed by YAPS DEVELOPER · YAPS Music v1.0

            Privacy & Terms

            Privacy Policy
            Terms of Service

            Last updated: August 2026

            Overview

            YAPS Music ("YAPS Music", "we", "us") is a music streaming and discovery platform built for Uganda and the wider region. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect when you use the app, how we use it, and the choices you have.

            Information We Collect

            Account information — name, email address, and password (stored securely, never in plain text) when you create an account.

            Usage data — songs you play, likes, follows, playlists, search history, and listening activity, used to power your Library, recommendations, and charts.

            Artist & upload data — if you use the Artist Dashboard, we collect the tracks, artwork, and metadata you upload, along with basic performance stats (plays, likes) for your releases.

            Device & local storage — preferences like theme, language, audio quality, and offline/downloaded content are stored locally on your device (browser localStorage), not on our servers.

            Tipping data — the mobile money tipping feature (MTN MoMo / Airtel Money) currently runs in demo mode. No real payment is processed and no financial account details are collected or transmitted by YAPS Music through this feature.

            How We Use Your Information

            We use your information to operate and improve YAPS Music: to play and recommend music, maintain your library and playlists, power artist tools, keep your account secure, and communicate important updates. We do not sell your personal information.

            Third-Party Services

            YAPS Music relies on a small number of third-party services to function: Supabase for account authentication, database, and file storage; YouTube for embedded video playback where available; and standard content-delivery services for fonts and icons. These providers process data only as needed to deliver those features.

            Your Choices

            You can update your profile, clear locally-stored preferences from Settings, and request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by contacting support. Uninstalling the app or clearing your browser data removes locally-stored information from your device.

            Children's Privacy

            YAPS Music is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under that age.

            Changes to This Policy

            We may update this Privacy Policy as YAPS Music evolves. Material changes will be reflected here with an updated "Last updated" date.

            Contact

            Questions about this policy or your data can be sent to support@yapsmusic.app.

            Last updated: August 2026

            Acceptance of Terms

            By creating an account or using YAPS Music, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please don't use the platform.

            Using YAPS Music

            You must provide accurate account information and are responsible for activity under your account. You agree not to misuse the platform — including attempting to disrupt the service, scraping content at scale, circumventing security measures, or uploading content you don't have rights to.

            Artist & User Content

            You retain ownership of tracks, artwork, and other content you upload through the Artist Dashboard. By uploading, you grant YAPS Music a license to host, stream, and display that content on the platform. You confirm you have the necessary rights to any content you upload, and that it does not infringe on others' copyrights or rights.

            Community Conduct

            Comments, messages, and other user content must not contain harassment, hate speech, illegal content, or spam. We may remove content or suspend accounts that violate these Terms.

            Tipping Feature

            The mobile money tipping feature is currently a demo and does not process real payments. It should not be relied on to send or receive actual funds.

            Disclaimers & Limitation of Liability

            YAPS Music is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform, to the fullest extent permitted by law.

            Termination

            You may stop using YAPS Music and request account deletion at any time. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms.

            Governing Law

            These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Uganda, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.

            Changes to These Terms

            We may update these Terms as YAPS Music evolves. Continued use after changes take effect means you accept the updated Terms.

            Contact

            Questions about these Terms can be sent to support@yapsmusic.app.
